items.stem: For a sports day at a school in Ranchi, the 36 students of Class XII are given roll numbers 1 to 36. items.markingKey: (i) reflexive, symmetric, transitive (1 mark) (ii) {5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35} (1 mark) (iii) one team per remainder: 5; sizes 7, 7, 7, 7, 8, largest 8 (2 marks).

items.stem: Let A = {1, 2, 3, …, 10} and R be the relation in A × A defined by (a, b) R (c, d) if a + d = b + c. Prove that R is an equivalence relation and obtain the equivalence class [(5, 2)].
items.markingKey: Reflexive: a + b = b + a (1 mark). Symmetric: a + d = b + c ⇒ c + b = d + a (1 mark). Transitive: a + d = b + c and c + f = d + e ⇒ a + f = b + e (2 marks). Class: (x, y) R (5, 2) ⇔ x + 2 = y + 5 ⇔ y − x = −3: {(4, 1), (5, 2), (6, 3), (7, 4), (8, 5), (9, 6), (10, 7)} (1 mark).
